1. The CEO was known for making __________ decisions that, while high-risk, frequently outperformed market expectations.
2. Her __________ approach to negotiations earned her a reputation as a fearless leader in the corporate sector.
questions.explanation: 'Audacious' means showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks, which fits seamlessly in both sentences describing high-risk decisions and a fearless leader.

questions.question: Pick the sentence that is grammatically CORRECT among the given choices.
options: Neither the manager nor his assistants was aware of the new policy changes implemented last week.
Scarcely had the speaker finished his speech than the audience broke into applause.
Not only did she pass the entrance examination, but she also secured the highest rank in the state.
If I was the Director of the bank, I would have approved the loan request immediately.
questions.explanation: Option C is grammatically correct. In Option A, 'assistants' is plural and closer to the verb, so the verb should be 'were'. In Option B, 'Scarcely' pairs with 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. In Option D, a hypothetical condition requires the subjunctive verb 'were' instead of 'was'.

questions.question: Which wholly-owned subsidiary of the Reserve Bank of India operates the currency note printing presses located at Mysuru (Karnataka) and Salboni (West Bengal)?
options: Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India Limited (SPMCIL)
Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Private Limited (BRBNMPL)
Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC)
questions.explanation: Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Private Limited (BRBNMPL), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the RBI, manages the two currency printing presses at Mysuru and Salboni. The other two main presses at Dewas and Nashik are owned by SPMCIL (a Government of India corporation).

questions.question: Under the revised Prompt Corrective Action (PCA) framework issued by the Reserve Bank of India for Scheduled Commercial Banks, which of the following parameters is NOT one of the core financial metrics used to monitor bank health?
questions.explanation: The RBI's Prompt Corrective Action (PCA) framework evaluates banks based on three key area parameters: Capital (CRAR / CET-1 Ratio), Asset Quality (Net NPA Ratio), and Leverage (Tier 1 Leverage Ratio). Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio is a prudential lending guideline for specific loans, not a PCA monitoring metric.

questions.question: Which national park in India is the world's only floating national park and the natural habitat of the endangered Sangai deer?
questions.explanation: Keibul Lamjao National Park, located on Loktak Lake in Manipur, is the world's only floating national park and is famous for being the home of the Sangai deer (brow-antlered deer).

questions.question: What is the official currency of South Korea?
questions.explanation: The official currency of South Korea is the South Korean Won (KRW).

questions.question: What is the primary scientific objective of ISRO's 'XPoSat' (X-ray Polarimeter Satellite) mission launched in January 2024?
options: To measure the polarization of intense celestial X-ray sources
To map lunar surface water ice deposits in high resolution
To provide precise positioning signals for civil aviation
To monitor soil moisture and vegetation cover globally
questions.explanation: XPoSat is India's dedicated polarimetry mission designed to study the polarization of celestial X-ray sources such as black holes, neutron stars, and active galactic nuclei.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the New Development Bank (NDB), established by the BRICS countries, located?
questions.explanation: The New Development Bank (NDB), formerly known as the BRICS Development Bank, has its headquarters located in Shanghai, China.

questions.question: Who authored the novel 'The White Tiger', which won the prestigious Man Booker Prize in 2008?
questions.explanation: 'The White Tiger' is the debut novel by Indian author Aravind Adiga, which won the 40th Man Booker Prize in 2008.

questions.question: In India, 'National Good Governance Day' is celebrated annually on December 25th to mark the birth anniversary of which former Prime Minister?
questions.explanation: Good Governance Day is observed every year on December 25 in India to honor the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

questions.question: Who was the first recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award (now renamed Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award) introduced in 1991–92?
questions.explanation: Grandmaster Viswanathan Anand was the first recipient of the Khel Ratna Award in the inaugural year 1991–92 for his outstanding performance in chess.

questions.question: Which country won its historic maiden Thomas Cup title in May 2022 by defeating 14-time champions Indonesia in the final?
questions.explanation: The Indian men's badminton team scripted history in May 2022 by winning their first-ever Thomas Cup title after defeating 14-time champions Indonesia 3-0 in Bangkok.

questions.question: Under Project 75 (P-75) of the Indian Navy, six Scorpène-class diesel-electric attack submarines were constructed by MDL. Which of the following is the sixth and final submarine delivered under this project?
questions.explanation: The six P-75 submarines are Kalvari, Khanderi, Karanj, Vela, Vagir, and Vagsheer. INS Vagsheer is the sixth and final submarine of the Project 75 sequence.

questions.question: The Nagoya Protocol, a supplementary agreement to the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD), primarily provides a framework for which of the following?
options: Control of transboundary movements of hazardous wastes and their disposal
Fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from the utilization of genetic resources
Phasing out the production and consumption of ozone-depleting substances
Establishing binding national targets for greenhouse gas emission reductions
questions.explanation: The Nagoya Protocol on Access to Genetic Resources and the Fair and Equitable Sharing of Benefits Arising from their Utilization (ABS) aims to ensure fair sharing of benefits derived from genetic resources.

questions.question:
In the following question, two equations numbered I and II are given. You have to solve both the equations and establish the relationship between x and y:
Equation I: x² - 7x + 12 = 0
Equation II: y² - 9y + 20 = 0
questions.explanation:
Solving Equation I: x² - 7x + 12 = 0 => (x - 3)(x - 4) = 0 => x = 3, 4.
Solving Equation II: y² - 9y + 20 = 0 => (y - 4)(y - 5) = 0 => y = 4, 5.
Comparing x and y:
When x = 3: x < 4 and x < 5 (x < y).
When x = 4: x = 4 and x < 5 (x ≤ y).
Overall, x ≤ y.

questions.question: The length and breadth of a rectangular field are in the ratio 5 : 3. If the perimeter of the field is 160 meters and a path of uniform width 2 meters is constructed all around the outside of the field, what is the area of the path?
questions.explanation:
Let length l = 5x and breadth b = 3x.
Perimeter = 2(l + b) = 2(5x + 3x) = 16x = 160 meters => x = 10.
So, Length = 50 m and Breadth = 30 m.
Area of inner rectangular field = 50 × 30 = 1500 m².
Outer length with path = 50 + 2(2) = 54 m.
Outer breadth with path = 30 + 2(2) = 34 m.
Area of outer rectangle = 54 × 34 = 1836 m².
Area of path = Outer Area - Inner Area = 1836 - 1500 = 336 m².

questions.question: Point M is 12m to the West of Point N. Point O is 5m to the North of Point N. Point P is 12m to the East of Point O. Point Q is 5m to the South of Point P. What is the distance between Point M and Point Q?
questions.explanation:
Taking M as origin (0,0):
Point N is 12m East of M -> (12, 0).
Point O is 5m North of N -> (12, 5).
Point P is 12m East of O -> (24, 5).
Point Q is 5m South of P -> (24, 0).
The distance between M (0,0) and Q (24,0) is 24m.

questions.question: Eight persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, and R are sitting in a straight line facing North. M sits third to the right of K. Neither M nor K sits at an extreme end. Only two persons sit between M and R. O sits second to the left of R. P sits to the immediate left of N. Q sits at one of the positions to the right of O. Who sits at the extreme left end of the line?
questions.explanation:
Numbering positions from 1 to 8 (Left to Right):
1. M sits third to the right of K, and neither sits at an extreme end. Possibilities for (K, M) are (2, 5), (3, 6), or (4, 7).
2. Only two persons sit between M and R. Since K already occupies the spot 3 steps away from M, R must be on the other side. Position 8 is available only when M is at 5. Thus, K is at 2, M is at 5, and R is at 8.
3. O sits second to the left of R, so O is at 6.
4. P sits to the immediate left of N. The only consecutive vacant spots are 3 and 4, so P is at 3 and N is at 4.
5. Q sits to the right of O, so Q is at 7.
6. The remaining person L must sit at position 1 (the extreme left end).
The final order from left to right is: L, K, P, N, M, O, Q, R.

questions.question: Identify the appropriate phrasal verb to complete the sentence: 'The board members decided to __________ the meeting until next Monday due to the unforeseen emergency.'
questions.explanation: 'Put off' means to postpone or delay an event to a later time. 'Put out' means to extinguish, 'put up' means to lodge or erect, and 'put away' means to store something.

questions.question:
Which of the given connectors best joins the two independent statements below to express a logical contrast?
Statement 1: 'The startup faced severe financial constraints during its initial months.'
Statement 2: 'It successfully managed to deliver the project ahead of the deadline.'
questions.explanation: 'Nevertheless' is a conjunctive adverb used to introduce a statement that contrasts with what was previously mentioned. 'Consequently' and 'Therefore' show cause and effect, while 'Furthermore' adds reinforcing information.

questions.question: As per the guidelines issued by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), what is the maximum per-transaction limit for a UPI Lite payment?
questions.explanation: In August 2023, the Reserve Bank of India increased the upper limit for a single UPI Lite transaction from ₹200 to ₹500, while retaining the overall wallet balance limit at ₹2,000.

questions.question: The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) was established in July 1982 based on the recommendations of which committee?
questions.explanation: NABARD was set up on July 12, 1982, on the recommendations of the Committee to Review Arrangements For Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development (CRAFICARD), which was chaired by B. Sivaraman.

questions.question: A trader marks an article 40% above its cost price and offers a discount of 15% on the marked price. If he earns a profit of ₹228, what is the cost price of the article?
questions.explanation:
Let the cost price (CP) be ₹x.
Marked Price (MP) = 1.40x
Selling Price (SP) = MP - Discount = 1.40x × (1 - 0.15) = 1.40x × 0.85 = 1.19x
Profit = SP - CP = 1.19x - x = 0.19x
Given profit = ₹228
0.19x = 228 => x = 228 / 0.19 = ₹1,200.

questions.question: The distance between stations X and Y is 385 km. Train A leaves station X at 8:00 AM towards Y at a speed of 50 km/h. Train B leaves station Y at 9:00 AM towards X at a speed of 70 km/h. At 10:00 AM, Train A suffers a mechanical fault and halts for 30 minutes before resuming its journey at the same speed. At what time will the two trains cross each other?
questions.explanation:
1. Distance traveled by Train A from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM (2 hours) = 2 × 50 = 100 km.
2. Train A halts from 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM.
3. Train B runs continuously from 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM (1.5 hours), distance covered = 1.5 × 70 = 105 km.
4. Total distance covered by both up to 10:30 AM = 100 + 105 = 205 km.
5. Remaining distance at 10:30 AM = 385 - 205 = 180 km.
6. Relative speed from 10:30 AM onwards = 50 + 70 = 120 km/h.
7. Time taken to meet = 180 / 120 = 1.5 hours (1 hour 30 mins).
8. Crossing time = 10:30 AM + 1 hour 30 mins = 12:00 PM.

questions.question: A person starts walking from Point A towards the South. After walking 15 meters, he turns right and walks 10 meters. He then turns left and walks 5 meters. Finally, he turns left and walks 10 meters to reach Point B. How far and in which direction is Point B with respect to Point A?
questions.explanation: Starting from A(0,0): 1) Walks 15m South to (0, -15). 2) Turns right (West) and walks 10m to (-10, -15). 3) Turns left (South) and walks 5m to (-10, -20). 4) Turns left (East) and walks 10m to (0, -20) to reach Point B. The distance between A(0,0) and B(0,-20) is 20 meters, and Point B is to the South of Point A.

questions.question: Six friends – A, B, C, D, E, and F – are sitting in a straight line facing North. A sits at one of the extreme ends of the line. C sits second to the right of A. Only two persons sit between C and F. E sits to the immediate left of B. If D does not sit at any of the extreme ends, who sits at the extreme right end of the line?
questions.explanation: Positioning from left to right (1 to 6): Since A is at an extreme end and C is second to the right of A, A must be at position 1 and C at position 3. Two persons sit between C and F, so F must be at position 6. E sits to the immediate left of B, occupying positions 4 and 5. The remaining position 2 is occupied by D. The arrangement from left to right is A - D - C - E - B - F. Hence, F sits at the extreme right end.

questions.question:
Read the sentence given below to find out whether there is any grammatical error in it. Select the option that contains the part with the error.

Sentence: Neither the manager nor the employees was aware of the sudden changes made to the safety guidelines.
questions.explanation: When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb must agree in number with the subject closest to it (the rule of proximity). Since 'employees' is plural, the plural verb 'were' should be used instead of 'was'. The correct phrase should be 'nor the employees were aware'.

questions.question:
Select the starter(s) from the given options that can be used to join the two sentences into a single grammatically correct sentence without changing the original meaning.

Statement 1: The government introduced strict measures to curb inflation.
Statement 2: Prices of essential commodities continued to rise rapidly.

I. Despite the government introducing...
II. Even though the government introduced...
III. Owing to the strict measures introduced...
questions.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 express a contrasting relationship (action taken vs. opposite/unexpected outcome). Starters I ('Despite...') and II ('Even though...') correctly denote concession and contrast. Starter III ('Owing to...') indicates a cause-and-effect relationship, which is contextually incorrect here.

questions.question: As per the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines, what percentage of Adjusted Net Bank Credit (ANBC) or Credit Equivalent Amount of Off-Balance Sheet Exposure, whichever is higher, is mandated as the overall target for Priority Sector Lending (PSL) in case of Small Finance Banks?
questions.explanation: Small Finance Banks (SFBs) are mandated to allocate 75% of their Adjusted Net Bank Credit (ANBC) or Credit Equivalent Amount of Off-Balance Sheet Exposure (CEOBE), whichever is higher, to Priority Sector Lending. Domestic scheduled commercial banks (excluding RRBs and SFBs) have a target of 40%.

questions.question: The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is a global reference code mandated by the Reserve Bank of India for financial transactions exceeding specified thresholds. How many alphanumeric characters does an LEI code consist of?
questions.explanation: The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is a 20-character alpha-numeric code based on the ISO 17442 standard. It is used to uniquely identify legal entities participating in financial transactions globally.

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 15 days, and B can complete the same work in 30 days. Working together, in how many days can they complete the work?
questions.explanation: A's 1-day work = 1/15. B's 1-day work = 1/30. Combined 1-day work = 1/15 + 1/30 = (2 + 1)/30 = 3/30 = 1/10. Therefore, working together they can complete the work in 10 days.

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys an item for ₹1,200. He marks it up by 50% above the cost price and then offers two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on the marked price. What is the net profit percentage earned by the shopkeeper?
questions.explanation: Cost Price (CP) = ₹1,200. Marked Price (MP) = 1,200 × 1.50 = ₹1,800. Selling Price (SP) after successive discounts = 1,800 × (1 - 0.20) × (1 - 0.10) = 1,800 × 0.80 × 0.90 = ₹1,296. Profit = SP - CP = ₹1,296 - ₹1,200 = ₹96. Profit Percentage = (96 / 1200) × 100 = 8%.

questions.question: In a test, five students – P, Q, R, S, and T – scored different marks. Q scored more than S but less than P. R scored more than T but less than S. Who among them scored the second highest marks?
questions.explanation:
Based on the given statements:
1. Q scored more than S but less than P: P > Q > S
2. R scored more than T but less than S: S > R > T
Combining both conditions: P > Q > S > R > T.
The highest score is P, and the second highest score is Q.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'DESIGN' is coded as 'FCUGIL'. How will 'REPORT' be coded in that same language?
questions.explanation:
The pattern followed is an alternating addition and subtraction of 2 to the alphabetical positions of letters (+2, -2, +2, -2, +2, -2):
D (+2) -> F
E (-2) -> C
S (+2) -> U
I (-2) -> G
G (+2) -> I
N (-2) -> L

Applying the same pattern to REPORT:
R (+2) -> T
E (-2) -> C
P (+2) -> R
O (-2) -> M
R (+2) -> T
T (-2) -> R

Thus, REPORT is coded as TCRMTR.

questions.question:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error:

'Neither the manager nor the team members was present at the annual conference yesterday.'
questions.explanation: When two subjects are connected by 'neither... nor', the verb must agree with the subject closest to it. Here, 'team members' is plural, so the plural verb 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.

questions.question:

questions.explanation: 'Specious' means superficially plausible but actually misleading or wrong, and 'dubious' means questionable or suspect. Both words fit the negative context of an argument failing to convince a panel due to lack of evidence.

questions.question: Which of the following types of financial institutions is NOT covered under the deposit insurance scheme of the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC)?
questions.explanation: DICGC covers all commercial banks operating in India (including Regional Rural Banks, Small Finance Banks, Local Area Banks, and foreign bank branches) as well as insured cooperative banks. Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) operate at the grassroots level and are not covered under the DICGC deposit insurance scheme.

questions.question: Under the Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) Scheme administered by the Reserve Bank of India, what is the maximum permissible subscription limit per fiscal year for Trusts and similar notified entities?
questions.explanation: According to RBI guidelines for the Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme, the maximum limit of subscription per fiscal year (April-March) is set at 4 kg for individuals, 4 kg for Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs), and 20 kg for Trusts and similar notified entities.

questions.question:
What value will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following expression?
(18² + 12 × 15) ÷ √144 = ?
questions.explanation: First, calculate inside the parentheses: 18² = 324 and 12 × 15 = 180. Sum = 324 + 180 = 504. √144 = 12. Finally, 504 ÷ 12 = 42.

questions.question:

45% of 800 + ?% of 750 = 60% of 1100 - 60
The average score of a batsman in 5 innings is 40 runs. If he scores 70 runs in the 6th inning, what is his new average?
questions.explanation: Total runs in 5 innings = 5 × 40 = 200. Total runs after 6th inning = 200 + 70 = 270. New average = 270 / 6 = 45.

questions.question: The average age of a group of 8 members is 40 years. A member aged 55 years leaves the group and a new member joins. As a result, the average age of the group decreases by 2 years. What is the age of the new member?
questions.explanation: Initial total age = 8 × 40 = 320 years. New average = 40 - 2 = 38 years. New total age = 8 × 38 = 304 years. Age of new member = 304 - (320 - 55) = 39 years.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'STATION' is coded as 'UVCVKQP'. How will 'BANKING' be coded in that same language?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2 positions (+2). B(+2)->D, A(+2)->C, N(+2)->P, K(+2)->M, I(+2)->K, N(+2)->P, G(+2)->I. So, 'BANKING' becomes 'DCPMKPI'.

questions.question: In a specific code language, 'GLAMOUR' is coded as 'JODPXRU'. Following the same rule, how is 'ROUTINE' coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter in 'GLAMOUR' is moved forward by 3 places (+3) in alphabetical order. Applying +3 to each letter in 'ROUTINE': R(+3)->U, O(+3)->R, U(+3)->X, T(+3)->W, I(+3)->L, N(+3)->Q, E(+3)->H. Thus, the code is 'URXWLQH'.

questions.question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the following number series?
7, 14, 28, 56, 112, ?
questions.explanation: Each term in the series is multiplied by 2. 7 × 2 = 14, 14 × 2 = 28, 28 × 2 = 56, 56 × 2 = 112, 112 × 2 = 224.

4, 11, 25, 53, 109, 223, 445

'The manager appreciated her **CANDID** feedback during the meeting.'
